said: Sister, day four baby, very sleepy since morning, doesn't cry, he only moves when we touch him or shake his feet, otherwise just lying
basis: Movement only when stimulated or no movement at all ... the presence of danger signs necessitates prompt clinical assessment, pre referral stabilization, and immediate referral
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026 (final 06-08-2026), Table 3.3 p.22 and text p.23

said: didi das din ka baccha hai, aaj subah se potty mein khoon aa raha hai, do baar dekha laal laal
basis: If a young infant has some or severe dehydration or blood in stool or any sign of possible serious bacterial infection ... Refer urgently to NBSU at CHC or SNCU at District Hospital.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Newborn and Child Health Services for CHO at AB-HWC (2021), p.27

said: बच्चा कल शाम से दूध नहीं खींच रहा, मुँह में लेता है फिर छोड़ देता है, रात भर कुछ नहीं पिया
basis: Not able to feed ... the presence of danger signs necessitates prompt clinical assessment, pre referral stabilization, and immediate referral
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Table 3.3 p.22 and text p.23

said: बाळ दहा दिवसाचं आहे, आज बघितलं तर तळवे आणि तळपाय पण पिवळे दिसतात, डोळे पण पिवळे
basis: Yellow palms and soles at any age ... Refer URGENTLY to NBSU at CHC or SNCU at District Hospital.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Newborn and Child Health Services for CHO (2021), jaundice classification table p.25

said: Day seven visit done. Baby weight two point nine kg. No fever, no fits, no fast breathing, no yellowness, feeding every two hours, cord is dry
basis: Danger signs of newborn (Multiple option selection) (If Any "YES", Referral Pop Up
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Form 3 (ASHA) p.113

said: teesra din hai, bukhar nahi hai, jhatke nahi aaye, saans normal chal rahi hai, peeliya nahi hai, doodh achhe se pee raha hai, haath pair garam hain
basis: Danger signs of newborn (Multiple option selection) (If Any "YES", Referral Pop Up
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Form 3 (ASHA) p.113

said: tisrya divshi baalacha chehra thoda pivla disto, pan talve ani talpay pivle nahit, dudh vyavasthit pito, zopet pan theek ahe
basis: Physiological jaundice does not extend to palms and soles and does not need any treatment.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Newborn and Child Health Services for CHO (2021), p.24

said: maine ek minute saans gini, sattar aayi, aur pasli bhi chal rahi hai, chhati andar ja rahi hai
basis: Fast breathing (more than 60 breaths per minute) ... Severe chest indrawing ... the presence of danger signs necessitates prompt clinical assessment, pre referral stabilization, and immediate referral
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Table 3.3 p.22 and text p.23

said: Baby feels cold to touch, I checked axillary temperature, it is thirty five point five
basis: Axillary temperature less than 36 °C (feels cold to touch) ... the presence of danger signs necessitates prompt clinical assessment, pre referral stabilization, and immediate referral
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Table 3.3 p.22 and text p.23

said: बच्चे का बदन गरम है, थर्मामीटर में सौ पॉइंट दो फारेनहाइट आया, आठवाँ दिन है
basis: Axillary temperature 37.5 °C or above (feels hot to touch) ... the presence of danger signs necessitates prompt clinical assessment, pre referral stabilization, and immediate referral
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Table 3.3 p.22 and text p.23

said: बच्चे के हाथ पैर अकड़ गए थे और दो बार झटके आए, अभी सो रहा है
basis: Convulsion ... the presence of danger signs necessitates prompt clinical assessment, pre referral stabilization, and immediate referral
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Table 3.3 p.22 and text p.23

said: नाळेतून थोडा पू येतोय, आजूबाजूला लालसर आहे, बाकी बाळ दूध पितं, ताप नाही
basis: Check for pus or bleeding from umbilicus: Yes/ No (If "YES", refer to health facility in consultation with ANM/ CHO)
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Form 3 (ASHA) p.114

said: Home delivery last night, I weighed the baby on the scale, only one point six kilo, baby is small but crying
basis: Weight < 1800 gm Refer URGENTLY to NBSU at CHC or SNCU at District Hospital
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Newborn and Child Health Services for CHO (2021), feeding problem classification p.28

said: maa bol rahi hai doodh kam aata hai, par baccha din mein das baara baar peeta hai, saat aath baar susu karta hai, vajan bhi badha hai
basis: Reassure the mother that all mothers produce enough milk for their baby
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Newborn and Child Health Services for CHO (2021), p.28

said: Day fourteen, weight two point four kg, she is feeding well, warm, active, no danger sign, mother doing KMC
basis: 'At-risk' newborns do not require immediate referral to a health facility unless danger signs are present.
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, section 4.5 p.54

said: saatwa mahina chal raha hai, kal raat se thoda thoda khoon aa raha hai neeche se, zyada nahi hai
basis: Any bleeding (light or heavy) at this time of pregnancy is dangerous. ... Refer such a woman immediately to an FRU
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Care During Pregnancy and Childbirth for CHO at AB-HWC (2021), APH p.43

said: नववा महिना आहे, सकाळपासून पाणी जातंय, कळा अजून सुरू नाहीत
basis: take the pregnant woman to the hospital immediately ... Bursting of water bag without labour pains
source: Mother and Child Protection card (MoHFW/MoWCD, English), danger-signs panel p.4

said: She has very bad headache since morning, says everything looks blurry, face and hands are swollen
basis: take the pregnant woman to the hospital immediately ... Headache, blurring of vision, fits and swelling all over the body
source: Mother and Child Protection card (MoHFW/MoWCD, English), danger-signs panel p.4

said: pichhli baar BP ek sau das by sattar tha, aaj ANM didi ne naapa to ek sau saath by ek sau baarah aaya
basis: she should immediately visit a PHC/FRU without waiting, be it day or night ... High BP (>140/90 mmHg) with or without proteins in the urine
source: MoHFW SBA Guidelines for Antenatal Care and Skilled Attendance at Birth (2010), Box 7 p.29

said: हीमोग्लोबिन आज साढ़े ग्यारह आया, पिछले महीने साढ़े छह था तब खून चढ़ाया था, अब ठीक लग रही है
basis: If haemoglobin levels have come up to normal level (Hb>10.9 gm/dl), discontinue the treatment and switch to prophylactic IFA dose.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Care During Pregnancy and Childbirth for CHO (2021), anaemia flow p.34

said: sahava mahina, raktasrav nahi, pani gela nahi, dokedukhi nahi, baal vyavasthit halta, BP ekshe vees by aiyshi
basis: If you or anyone in your family sees any of these danger signs, take the pregnant woman to the hospital immediately
source: Mother and Child Protection card (MoHFW/MoWCD, English), danger-signs panel p.4 (none present)

said: Fourth month, she has nausea and some vomiting in the morning, heartburn and constipation, but she is eating and drinking okay
basis: Normal symptoms during pregnancy – Nausea and vomiting, heartburn, constipation, and increased frequency of urination.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Care During Pregnancy and Childbirth for CHO (2021), p.17

said: shaam ko pairon mein thodi sujan aa jaati hai, subah utar jaati hai, chehra theek hai, BP ek sau bees by assi
basis: Oedema (swelling), which appears in the evening and disappears in the morning after a full night's sleep, could be a normal manifestation of pregnancy.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Care During Pregnancy and Childbirth for CHO (2021), p.19

said: आठवाँ महीना है, कल से बच्चा बिल्कुल हिल नहीं रहा, पेट में कोई हलचल नहीं
basis: she should immediately visit a PHC/FRU without waiting, be it day or night ... Decreased or absent foetal movements
source: MoHFW SBA Guidelines (2010), Box 7 p.29

said: हिमोग्लोबिन साडेसहा आलं, थोडं चाललं तरी दम लागतो, खूप थकवा आहे
basis: take the pregnant woman to the hospital immediately ... Severe Anemia with or without breathlessness
source: Mother and Child Protection card (MoHFW/MoWCD, English), danger-signs panel p.4

said: सहावा महिना आहे, ती म्हणते मला आता जगायचं नाही, सगळं संपवून टाकावं असं वाटतं
basis: Ask for thoughts of suicide. If present, discuss with the Medical Officer immediately.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on MNS Disorders Care for Staff Nurses at AB-HWC, depressive disorders p.23

said: teen din se tez bukhar hai, ek sau do, kanpkanpi ke saath aata hai, paanchva mahina
basis: take the pregnant woman to the hospital immediately ... High fever during pregnancy or within one month of delivery
source: Mother and Child Protection card (MoHFW/MoWCD, English), danger-signs panel p.4

said: BP is one forty-eight by ninety-four today, urine albumin nil, no headache, no swelling
basis: If the woman has high blood pressure but no urine albumin, she should be referred to the PHC Medical Officer.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Care During Pregnancy and Childbirth for CHO (2021), p.20

said: delivery ko chhe din hue, bukhar ek sau ek hai aur neeche se badbu wala paani aa raha hai, pet mein dard bhi
basis: Counsel the mother to go directly to the FRU without waiting if she notices the following danger signs: ... Fever ... Foul-smelling lochia
source: MoHFW SBA Guidelines (2010), Module I danger signs after delivery p.63

said: आधे घंटे में तीन पैड भीग गए, बड़े बड़े थक्के निकल रहे हैं, कल ही डिलीवरी हुई
basis: Excessive bleeding, i.e. soaking more than 2–3 pads in 20–30 minutes after delivery.
source: MoHFW SBA Guidelines (2010), Module I danger signs after delivery p.63

said: aaj sakalpasun saha pad badlale, chakkar yete, khup ashakta vatate
basis: Excessive bleeding during delivery or after delivery ... changing pad 5 or more/ day
source: MCP card danger-signs panel p.4 ("immediately"); SSBSK 2026 Form 4 p.115

said: Day seven PNC. Bleeding is less, two pads a day, no fever, no foul smell, BP one eighteen by seventy six, breastfeeding well
basis: Bleeding(confirm number of pads should be less than 5/day)?
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Care During Pregnancy and Childbirth for CHO (2021), PNC history p.50

said: pehle din chhe pad lage the, ab gyarah din ho gaye, ek do pad roz lagta hai, bukhar nahi hai
basis: Bleeding(confirm number of pads should be less than 5/day)?
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Care During Pregnancy and Childbirth for CHO (2021), PNC history p.50

said: didi woh keh rahi hai ab jeene ka mann nahi karta, sab khatam kar dungi, baccha bhi theek se nahi sambhal rahi
basis: Ask for thoughts of suicide. If present, discuss with the Medical Officer immediately.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on MNS Disorders Care for Staff Nurses at AB-HWC, depressive disorders p.23

said: She told me quietly she sometimes gets thoughts of hurting the baby, like dropping him, and she is scared of herself
basis: When there is risk of suicide or harm to others
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on MNS Disorders Care for Staff Nurses at AB-HWC, red flags in SMDs p.32

said: गेले तीन आठवडे ती उदास असते, कशातच मन लागत नाही, बाळाकडे पण लक्ष देत नाही
basis: Is the mother feeling down, depressed or hopeless? ... If any of the two questions are answered as "Yes", then prompt for referral to CHO/MO
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Form 4 psychological distress p.115

said: paanchva din hai, thodi udaas hai, baat baat pe ro deti hai, baaki khana kha rahi hai, doodh pila rahi hai
basis: Does she feel unhappy or cry easily? This indicates post-partum depression, and usually occurs 4-7 days after delivery. Assure her that everything will be fine and refer her to the MO only if the problem persists.
source: MoHFW/NHSRC Training Manual on Care During Pregnancy and Childbirth for CHO (2021), PNC second/third visit p.53

said: वो कल से अजीब अजीब बातें कर रही है, रात भर सोई नहीं, घरवालों को पहचान नहीं रही
basis: Neurological symptoms (Blurred vision / Convulsion/ Speaking Abnormally)
source: SSBSK Operational Guidelines 2026, Form 4 p.115; HBNC 2014 home visit form p.19 ("If yes, refer the mother to hospital")

said: Ten days after delivery, she has burning while passing urine and fever one hundred three
basis: Urinary Tract Infection (High fever >102°F, burning urination) ... High fever during pregnancy or within one month of delivery
source: SSBSK 2026 Form 4 p.115; MCP card danger-signs panel p.4 ("immediately")

said: sirf do baar khana kha rahi hai din mein, bhookh kam hai bolti, baaki sab theek, bleeding kam hai
basis: If less than 4 times or if meals not full, advise mother to do so.
source: HBNC Operational Guidelines 2014, Annexure 1c home visit form p.19
